title: AI News: OpenAI is up to something *new*

comments.author: @novantha1
comments.text: I think that automating video games is a huge step towards generally useful AI models. There's so many things you have to get right in order to play a game, particularly an open ended game, and plenty of those things have crossover with the real world in a variety of capacities. From things like object permanence to strategizing, to operating in an environment in an agentic way... These are all things that somebody is going to randomly figure out one day and go "oh, that's neat, I can automate X task I don't want to do in the game" only to fail to realize that "Oh, there's a related task in the real world that doesn't need to be done by people anymore".
